pass_b_english: Cyril: …doors of the tent of the testimony. And you will take from the blood of the calf, and you will set upon the two horns of the altar with your finger. And all the remaining blood you will pour out beside the base of the altar, and you will take all the fat upon the belly, and the lobe upon the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat upon them, and you will set upon the altar. And the meats of the calf, and the skin, and the dung you will burn with fire outside the camp; for it is of sin. And the one ram you will take, and Aaron and his sons will set their hands upon the head of the ram, and you will slaughter it, and taking the blood you will pour toward the altar in a circle, and you will divide the ram according to limbs; and you will wash the inwards and the feet with water, and you will set upon the divided-parts with the head, and you will bring up the whole ram upon the altar, a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord unto a smell of fragrance; it is incense to Lord. And you will take… and what has been removed from the ram of the perfection from Aaron and from his sons, and it will be for Aaron and for his sons an age-long lawful thing from the sons of Israel; for this is a setting-apart, and a removal it will be from the sons of Israel from the victims of the salvations of the sons of Israel, a removal to Lord.’ And after a few: ‘And the ram of the perfection you will take, and you will boil the meats in a holy place, and Aaron and
